title: zanthoxylum laurentii

This plant has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to aid digestion, reduce inflammation, and alleviate pain. The therapeutic actions of Zanthoxylum laurentii include its analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as amide alkaloids, phenolic acids, and volatile oils. The bioactive constituents of Zanthoxylum laurentii, including hydroxy-alpha-sanshool, have been shown to have potential therapeutic effects, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties.
